scope: Two sequential diagnostic captures of the pinned running Riemann GUI. No source edits, chat/inference, restart or runtime deployment. Real offline Lake tools and existing persisted caches. The second capture separates settled graph and map idle windows.

artifact_manifest.limits: Current-user native host and inherited workers only; no kernel stacks. Thread CPU spans exclude worker CPU. File preparation reuses project/OS caches, not a cold installation. Sampling changes timing; browser profiles have their own overhead.

findings.finding: A complete persisted-cache open still takes 40.04–41.20 seconds. Twelve Lake configuration executions total 17.12–17.23 seconds; prepared build/input resolution and fingerprinting takes 17.87–19.03 seconds.
findings.action: Reuse evaluated package configuration and prepared immutable input observations with explicit freshness/invalidation. Preserve exact input and resource checks; do not treat the entire prepare stage as hashing alone.

findings.finding: Map wheel handler p95 is 10.32–10.86 ms versus 1.00–1.05 ms for the dependency graph. NativeWorkspaceGraph render uses scene.areas.some(declarationDetail) over the full inventory to decide legend visibility. The sampled declarationDetail/fade call path passes through WorkspaceMap.
findings.action: Derive legend visibility from the existing viewport index; use the same visible-area set for rendering, loading and legend decisions. Breadcrumb onMoveEnd also retains a whole-area scan and needs separate treatment.

findings.finding: Retained tab click handlers take 20.70–21.81 ms p95. The node-selection sequence including explicit Fit View takes 32.08–33.12 ms p95 and one run has a 53 ms long task. No measured gesture/tab phase issued non-state API requests.
findings.action: Reduce map reactivation scans and source/popover layout work. Keep prepared tabs alive; investigate selection tail separately from handler time.

findings.finding: Neither current capture reproduces the historical approximately 384 ms map materialization in its initial idle window. The second capture has no long tasks in settled graph/map idle windows. This is not evidence that every state poll rebuilds the map.
findings.action: Capture whole-inventory materialization during initial overview arrival or revision changes separately; avoid attributing a one-time initialization pause to periodic polling.

limitations: EventDispatch is handler wall time, not complete user latency. Phase input-to-two-rAF combines the instrumented event types; it is a presentation proxy, not physical presentation or field INP.

Two sequential captures on one unthrottled desktop are diagnostic observations, not population percentiles or confidence intervals. Resize events may be coalesced. The nine-click node sequence includes one Fit View and repeated selection of a reachable node.
Nested native stages overlap and must not be added. Host thread CPU excludes subprocess CPU; wall minus thread CPU is not an I/O-wait measurement.

The production minified bundle has no matching local source map. Function attribution was checked against its actual function body and call tree; unresolved Lean-library symbols are not assigned speculative names.
No cold installation, uncached compilation/search latency, model latency, arbitrary large per-file graph performance or new refinement assurance is established.
